note: Costs exactly as reported in each paper (computed with that paper's own numerics). They become 'verified' only when a controller file is submitted and re-scored by the reference evaluator. Text fields may contain inline LaTeX between dollar signs. A claim with evidence that its printed cost is not the cost of the paper's controller has a 'disputed' record: the date, a one-sentence reason, and note, the path of a note in notes/ that explains the check and links its scripts. A disputed claim keeps its printed cost, is hidden on the leaderboard unless Disputed is ticked, and never counts as the best claimed cost.
